name: Floette
description: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.

moves.name: Vine Whip
moves.description: The target is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

moves.name: Fairy Wind
moves.description: The user attacks by stirring up a fairy wind to strike the target.

moves.name: Safeguard
moves.description: The user creates a protective field that prevents status conditions for five turns.

moves.name: Razor Leaf
moves.description: Sharp-edged leaves are launched to slash at opposing Pokémon. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Wish
moves.description: One turn after this move is used, the user's or its replacement's HP is restored by up to half the user's max HP.

moves.name: Magical Leaf
moves.description: The user scatters curious leaves that chase the target. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Grassy Terrain
moves.description: The user turns the ground into Grassy Terrain for five turns. This restores the HP of Pokémon on the ground a little every turn and powers up Grass-type moves.

moves.name: Petal Blizzard
moves.description: The user stirs up a violent petal blizzard and damages everything around it.

moves.name: Synthesis
moves.description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

moves.name: Misty Terrain
moves.description: This protects Pokémon on the ground from status conditions and halves damage from Dragon-type moves for five turns.

moves.name: Moonblast
moves.description: Borrowing the power of the moon, the user attacks the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Petal Dance
moves.description: The user attacks the target by scattering petals for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.description: The user gathers light on the first turn, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.description: The user gathers light on the first turn, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.description: The target is hit with a strong telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Light Screen
moves.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from special moves for five turns.

moves.name: Metronome
moves.description: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user's HP and cures any status conditions.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its own HP. The substitute serves as the user's decoy.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Giga Drain
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. This move's chance of failing rises if used in succession.

moves.name: Charm
moves.description: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. This harshly lowers the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: The user randomly uses one of the moves it knows. This move can only be used while the user is asleep.

moves.name: Baton Pass
moves.description: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type attacks. The rain also lowers the power of Fire-type attacks.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type attacks. The sunlight also lowers the power of Water-type attacks.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This move's power is doubled if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.description: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of that ally's attack.

moves.name: Trick
moves.description: The user catches the target off guard and swaps the target's held item with its own.

moves.name: Endeavor
moves.description: The user inflicts damage by cutting down the target's HP to roughly equal the user's HP.

moves.name: Skill Swap
moves.description: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.

moves.name: Magical Leaf
moves.description: The user scatters curious leaves that chase the target. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Calm Mind
moves.description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to boost its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

moves.name: Seed Bomb
moves.description: The user attacks by slamming a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.

moves.name: Energy Ball
moves.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Grass Knot
moves.description: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Stored Power
moves.description: The user attacks the target with stored power. The more the user's stats are boosted, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Petal Blizzard
moves.description: The user stirs up a violent petal blizzard and damages everything around it.

moves.name: Disarming Voice
moves.description: Letting out a charming cry, the user does emotional damage to opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Draining Kiss
moves.description: The user steals the target's HP with a kiss. The user's HP is restored by over half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Grassy Terrain
moves.description: The user turns the ground into Grassy Terrain for five turns. This restores the HP of Pokémon on the ground a little every turn and powers up Grass-type moves.

moves.name: Misty Terrain
moves.description: This protects Pokémon on the ground from status conditions and halves damage from Dragon-type moves for five turns.

moves.name: Dazzling Gleam
moves.description: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

moves.name: Pollen Puff
moves.description: The user attacks the enemy with a pollen puff that explodes. If the target is an ally, it gives the ally a pollen puff that restores its HP instead.

moves.name: Tera Blast
moves.description: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

moves.name: Trailblaze
moves.description: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user's nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.

moves.name: Chilling Water
moves.description: The user attacks the target by showering it with water that's so cold it saps the target's power. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: Alluring Voice
moves.description: The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.
